name: Sakaki Akane
source:
"Passionate Head of the Drama Club (情熱溢れる演劇部部長)"

The president of the drama club who's in the same year as the protagonist and Momiji, and who is very serious about drama plays. Has very strong sense of responsibility.

Akane has a very strict, rigorous personality and does act like a male friend towards the protagonist. She doesn't like to be treated like a girl, but will get angry if treated like a guy which makes it a bit of a pain for her friends.
